blocked.reason: PROVENANCE_CONFLICT: overlapping legacy data_600K/foundation and later data/scratch artifacts

md_protocol.equilibration: No separate restart/equilibration stage; fresh-start Langevin trajectory is retained and production-window exclusions are recorded in post-processing.
md_protocol.heat_flux: Repository simplified stress-based convention; only used when stress is present in the trajectory or recomputed from the exact model. Otherwise HFACF/kappa are unavailable.

acceptance_gates.identity: 2050 atoms, fixed species order, fixed cell, fully periodic PBC
acceptance_gates.finite: finite positions, momenta, energy, temperature, force, and saved observables
acceptance_gates.stability: temperature <= 5000 K, max force <= 100 eV/A, min distance >= 0.5 A
acceptance_gates.transport: Dxy/HFACF/kappa remain exploratory until window, block, and replica convergence are demonstrated
acceptance_gates.failure_model: unstable — no Dxy; retain first-divergence frame and diagnostics

comparison_sources.old_continuation_protocol_note: Existing FT-600K/FT-MultiT outputs are 1 ns continuation analyses with different model/input/start-step provenance; retain as labeled reference, not protocol-identical replicas.

monitoring.policy: quiet when healthy and unchanged; notify on failure, scientific-gate change, checkpoint stall, continuation decision, or completion
